checks: resolve one pre-effect signed dispatch-boundary artifact to the exact child request
verify root, authority, child, delegation, principal and authenticated credential liveness
reconstruct scoped root, authority, child, delegation, principal and credential revocations through the boundary time
verify exact review, current Policy, reservation, revocation, expiry and idempotency state

require dispatch ownership to commit before provider network egress
